Consultancy Services for M&E Specialist for online and M&E system
tenders.closing_date: 8 May 2026 The consultant will design a Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) framework and manual and support the development of a centralised online M&E system to strengthen the Government of Vanuatu’s capacity to monitor climate change initiatives and climate finance. Working under SPC supervision and in coordination with the NDA Office, the consultant will define indicators, data sources, roles, and reporting processes aligned with GCF requirements and national systems. The consultant will provide technical guidance to support integration of the M&E framework into the upgraded NAB portal, including indicators, datasets, and dashboards, and develop training materials and deliver in‑country training for NDA and relevant government officials.

tenders.title: Consultancy Services for IT Specialist
tenders.closing_date: 8 May 2026 The consultant will review existing national digital platforms and identify opportunities to integrate climate change and development data into a centralised online system, aligned with the upgraded NAB portal. In coordination with the NDA, SPC’s CFU, and technical specialists, the consultant will design and develop a centralised M&E system and an online climate finance tracking system, including data management, reporting, and dashboards. The consultant will also develop training materials and deliver in‑country training for NDA and relevant government officials.

tenders.title: Consultancy Services for Climate Finance Tracking Specialist
tenders.closing_date: 8 May 2026 The Climate Finance Tracking Specialist will be engaged to develop a national framework and online system for tracking climate finance and climate‑related initiatives in Vanuatu. The assignment aims to strengthen government capacity for improved tracking, reporting, coordination, and decision‑making. The system will be integrated, where possible, with the upgraded NAB portal. Working closely with the NDA, SPC’s Climate Finance Unit, MFEM, and an IT Systems Specialist, the consultant will review existing tools and methodologies, define indicators and data requirements aligned with national and international reporting standards, and support the development of a centralised online climate finance tracking system. The consultant will also develop and deliver training to relevant government officials.

tenders.closing_date: 24 April 2026 This consultancy aims to strengthen the capacity of the FSM NDA Office to identify, access, and effectively manage international climate finance. The consultant will provide strategic, technical, and advisory support to maximise FSM’s access to climate finance, align funding with national and sub-national priorities, and support the development and quality assurance of climate finance strategies and GCF project pipelines. The role includes building partnerships across donors, accredited entities, government, civil society, and the private sector; supporting readiness and capacity-building efforts; advising on financing options for FSM’s climate action needs; and ensuring that climate projects are technically sound, economically feasible, and aligned with country priorities.
